en: Saññojanādi-cha-gocchaka, Kusalattika (The Group of Six beginning with Fetters, Wholesome Triplet)
Conditioned by a state that is neither a fetter nor unwholesome, a fettered unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a state that is neither a tie nor unwholesome, a tied unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, there are three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, there are three.
Conditioned by a state that is neither a flood nor unwholesome, a flood that is unwholesome arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the root condition, there are three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, there are three.
Conditioned by a state that is neither yoga nor unwholesome, a state that is yoga and unwholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three [results] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a state that is neither hindrance nor unwholesome, a state that is a hindrance and unwholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Conditioned by a state that is neither grasping nor unwholesome, there arises a state that is grasping and unwholesome by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
